entry.title: My Mom Found Me After 730 Days | After Walmart (Finale)

media:group.media:title: My Mom Found Me After 730 Days | After Walmart (Finale)
media:group.media:description:
A year in a Walmart. A year behind a hospital gate. On Day 365, his mom is standing on the road outside.
One Year Inside, Season 2, Part 4: the finale. An original animated survival series.
What is IT? Something out in the dark with no voice of its own. It only repeats what real people said, it listens through anything that carries a voice, and anyone it gets at night loses the days. Nobody ever found out where it came from. This is where the story ends.
